name: ui_swipe
description: Perform a directional swipe gesture. Specify direction (up, down, left, right) and optional duration in milliseconds. The swipe covers roughly 2/3 of the screen. Use for scrolling lists, dismissing panels, or navigating between pages.

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)

duration_ms.description: Duration of the swipe in milliseconds (default: 300)

region.description: Screen-space region [x1,y1,x2,y2] to swipe within; the largest scrollable inside it is used, else the region itself.

scrollable.description: Scrollable element to swipe within, matched by resource-id/text/content-desc substring (case-insensitive). Default: the largest scrollable element on the focused panel.

arguments.description: Generated MCP request struct for this tool.
arguments.title: UiSwipeRequest
